## design-hiker-skill v0.1.1

- No file changes detected in this version.
- Documentation, metadata, and functionality remain unchanged.

- Initial release of design-spec-personal skill (v0.6.1, "icon-quality-gate" phase).
- Delivers hi-fi prototypes and detailed implementation specs from varied design inputs (text, image, Sketch, Figma).
- Supports multiple platforms (mobile H5, web PC) and integrates universal, standard, or brand design profiles.
- Outputs: interactive preview, spec-annotated HTML, tokens CSS, machine-readable specs, inference logs, QA measurement, and acceptance contracts.
- Supports W3C/Style Dictionary Token import and profile creation.
- Outputs all materials in a unified project directory for streamlined delivery.
